Part of the [pycyxwiz API reference](index.md), pycyxwiz 0.2.0: each name with the signature and description the module itself reports. Types are shown without the `pycyxwiz.` prefix; `Sequence[int]` is any list or tuple of integers.

## Functions

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `create_activation(type: ActivationType, alpha: float = 0.009999999776482582) -> Activation` | Create an activation function by type |
| `dropout(input: Tensor, p: float = 0.5, training: bool = True) -> Tensor` | Apply dropout during training |
| `elu(input: Tensor, alpha: float = 1.0) -> Tensor` | Apply ELU activation |
| `flatten(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Flatten spatial dimensions |
| `gelu(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Apply GELU activation |
| `hardsigmoid(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Apply Hardsigmoid activation: relu6(x + 3) / 6 |
| `hardswish(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Apply Hardswish activation: x * relu6(x + 3) / 6 |
| `leaky_relu(input: Tensor, negative_slope: float = 0.009999999776482582) -> Tensor` | Apply LeakyReLU activation |
| `mish(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Apply Mish activation |
| `relu(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Apply ReLU activation: f(x) = max(0, x) |
| `relu6(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Apply ReLU6 activation: min(max(x, 0), 6) |
| `sigmoid(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Apply Sigmoid activation: f(x) = 1 / (1 + exp(-x)) |
| `silu(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Apply SiLU activation (alias for Swish) |
| `softmax(input: Tensor, dim: int = -1) -> Tensor` | Apply Softmax activation |
| `swish(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Apply Swish activation: f(x) = x * sigmoid(x) |
| `tanh(input: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Apply Tanh activation: f(x) = tanh(x) |

## Enumerations

- `ActivationType`: `ReLU`, `Sigmoid`, `Tanh`, `Softmax`, `LeakyReLU`, `ELU`, `GELU`, `Swish`, `SiLU`, `Mish`, `Hardswish`, `Hardsigmoid`, `ReLU6`, `SELU`, `PReLU`, `SquaredReLU`, `GELUExact`
